a1d877653d.why: Old tell fixed. The stem no longer has the prism or the band of colours that gave the answer away. It asks the fact plainly, and all three lures are live beliefs: one colour white, one colour yellow, the painters' red, yellow and blue. Choices are two parallel pairs. Facts true. White light is a mix of the colours of the visible spectrum, red to violet (Grokipedia Visible spectrum: Newton showed 'white light is composed of a mixture of colors'). Sunlight looks white (Grokipedia Sunlight; NASA: white from above the air). A prism spreads it, and an inverted second prism recombines it (UNSW, Newton's own words). Virginia SOL 5.3 teaches it at grade 5 ('The sum of these colors is white light'). Context true. Voice clean.
